A LONG: the fee is CHARGED, not credited

A/B SHORT: final cash matches the hand computation

A/B SHORT: the exit is the target

D LONG: the gap-through stop fills AT THE OPEN

D SHORT: the gap-through stop fills AT THE OPEN

F: eq[-1]-INIT == sum(pnl) - funding on every synthetic case
G: 'full' turnover closes and reopens the selected leg at the rebalance
G: 'keep' turnover does NOT close a leg that stays selected
G: the 'keep' reading trades less than the 'full' one (that is the whole cost difference)
G: an unknown turnover mode is refused
H: the entry bar's own range is checked (a stop on the fill bar exits immediately)
I: an asymmetric stop/target (1x ATR stop, 3x ATR target) runs and fills the order
I: the asymmetric TARGET level is the one used
